structure.unit: Department for Aging and Rehabilitative Services
Community-Based Services for People With Disabilities

law.catch_line: Participation by clients in cost of services
law.text: The Commissioner shall establish written standards for determining the extent to which a client shall be financially responsible for the cost of services funded in whole or in part by the Department. Each public or private agency awarded a grant or contract in accordance with § 51.5-161 shall utilize the Commissioner's regulations to maximize the financial participation of persons receiving services.
